outside_sandbox_probe.script:
import pathlib,sqlite3,tempfile,json,os,sys
from contextlib import closing
root=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="deskmate-c14-cold-"))
result={"python":sys.version,"sqlite":sqlite3.sqlite_version,"root":str(root),"observations":[]}
for mode in ("DELETE","WAL"):
 path=root/(mode+".sqlite")
 with closing(sqlite3.connect(path)) as db:
  db.execute("CREATE TABLE example(value)")
  db.execute("INSERT INTO example VALUES (42)")
  db.commit()
  db.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode="+mode)
 observation={"mode":mode,"before":sorted(p.name for p in root.iterdir()),"directory_writable":os.access(root,os.W_OK)}
 try:
  with closing(sqlite3.connect(path.as_uri()+"?mode=ro",uri=True)) as db:
   observation["rows"]=db.execute("SELECT * FROM example").fetchall()
 except sqlite3.Error as error:
  observation.update(error=str(error),error_name=getattr(error,"sqlite_errorname",None))
 observation["after"]=sorted(p.name for p in root.iterdir())
 result["observations"].append(observation)
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
